sense: a notice, a board with writing

terms.comment: The notice put up on a house for sale or to let, the label on a jar, a placard.

terms.gloss: board; a board with writing on it
evidence: Cic. Caecin. 16 (Lewis & Short: a tablet advertising an auction)
M-O s.v. bulletin board: nūntiōrum tabula
terms.comment: The board itself; a notice board is nūntiōrum tabula (Morgan–Owens).

terms.gloss: the writing on something, an inscription
terms.comment: The wording rather than the board.

phrases.latin: Venit Athēnās philosophus Athēnodōrus, lēgit titulum audītōque pretiō …
phrases.english: the philosopher Athenodorus came to Athens, read the notice, and when he heard the price …

sources: Lewis & Short: titulus · Lewis & Short: tabula · Lewis & Short: inscriptio
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. bulletin board.
Pliny’s letters checked against the Perseus Latin texts (9 November 2026).
